title: The Dragonbone Chair
author: Tad Williams
summary: A kitchen boy in a great castle grows up in the shadow of a dying king. When the old order collapses and something ancient stirs in the north, he is swept into a war far bigger than anything he imagined.
readIf: you like long, patient epic fantasy that takes its time building a world and a hero you grow up alongside.
skipIf: you want a quick start, because the early chapters are slow and the plot only fully opens up later.

pairings.reason: Another classic farm-boy-to-epic quest, with a similarly slow-burn, travel-heavy structure.
A lonely royal servant's son growing up, but told in a more intimate, emotional first person.
A comparable castle-and-succession crisis, written with far more brutality and politics.
